utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is this Saturday on the front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, that’s right — this Saturday on the front porch. I’m in, and once Rosa sends the full list, I’ll help keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. Can you also keep me posted if Rosa sends that full list today?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m on it — I’ll check the list and timing for Saturday, then let you know ASAP.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Dane. Please check the list and timing, and meet me at the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll check the details and meet you at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s this Saturday on the front porch, and I still need a few helpers to sort donations and mark what’s usable. If you can lend a hand, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, so I don’t want to show up at the wrong time or place. I can help sort donations if that’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks for checking — I’ve only got Saturday at the front porch, so I’d stick with that for now. And yes, sorting donations would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the hammer and screwdriver ready for the repair drive—where should I drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great—could you bring them to the front porch this Saturday? That would help a lot with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver to the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can still help sort the donated items and mark what works, but keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo—if you can sort and mark the donated items, please bring them to my front porch by Friday afternoon so I can set up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I’ll sort and mark them, then drop them by your porch Friday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for checking in, Jules. It’s this Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help for a bit Saturday morning, and I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors about bringing tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Jules—thank you. If you can, ask folks to swing by Saturday morning with any tools or spare parts they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can do that—I'll ask around and bring you the list of what's still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mina. Please bring me the list, and I’ll line up the helpers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll ask around and get you the list of what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — even sorting tools or greeting neighbors would be a big help. Thanks, Noah, I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can sort tools and greet folks at the front porch this Saturday. Just point me to whatever needs fixing most!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Noah — thank you. I’ll point you to the first things that need fixing when you get here this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Oren — quick update, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. What should we prioritize first for supplies or help?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rosa — let’s prioritize tables, tape, and a couple extra hands for sorting. Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll line up tables, tape, and a couple extra hands for sorting. Thanks, Oren; I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — I could really use help setting up at the front porch this Saturday. If you can come by a bit early, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can come by early and help set up at the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s wonderful, Ira — thank you. Come by a little early and I’ll have everything ready for us at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s this Saturday at the front porch, and we’re still gathering supplies—anything spare would really help. I’ll send over the full list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik—just keep spreading the word, and I’ll send the full supply list soon. Any spare tools or repair supplies can be dropped off at the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know to drop off any spare tools or repair supplies at the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the details for this Saturday at the front porch so you can see what’s needed and decide. If you want, I can also put your name on the helpers list for now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — please send the details first, and I’ll decide once I know exactly what’s needed. I’d rather wait on the helpers list until I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll send the details first, and then you can let me know if you want on the helpers list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Vik — just a heads-up, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. Let me know if you want to help with setup or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works, and I can help with setup. Let me know what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — could you be there at 9:00 AM to help set up? I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on the exact drop-off spot for the supplies and repair kits, but as soon as I have it, I’ll let you know so you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — once you have the exact drop-off spot, please send it over with the time too, so I can share the right details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll send you the exact drop-off spot and the time as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—did the repair drive get enough help?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not quite yet, but I’m ready to help and bring the hammer and screwdriver. Where should I drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus—that helps a lot. Bring them to the front porch this Saturday, and I’ll be there to meet you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep—it's this Saturday on the front porch, and I still need a few helpers to sort and set things up. If you can lend a hand, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help sort the donated items and label what works, but keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s perfect, Bo—sorting and labeling is exactly what I need. I’ll keep it quick and see you Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m in, and I can keep track of the supplies for Saturday. Just tell me what you need me to bring first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo. Please bring labels, tape, and a pen first, and I’ll keep you posted on anything else we need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’ll bring labels, tape, and a pen on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I still need a few helpers this Saturday at the front porch. If you can lend a hand, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — I can help for a bit this Saturday at the front porch. Just tell me what to do.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo—could you help greet people at the porch and sort donations for the first hour?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes — I just wanted to make sure you’re still definitely in for the repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still in for Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll text you the details for Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I can greet people and sort tools when I get there. Do you still need someone to keep track of the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes please, if you can keep an eye on the supplies too, that would help a lot. Thanks, Noah — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I’ll keep an eye on the supplies too. I may be a bit scattered, but I’ll do my best on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—how’s it going so far?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’m just making sure everyone gets the new details. We’ll still need help with supplies and setup, if you’re available.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center, got it. I can help spread the word, and I’ll see if I can lend a hand with setup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details and make sure you’re added for the repair drive. Thanks for helping spread the word too!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what time should I tell people to come, and do you still need any setup help?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Saturday at 10 a.m. at the front porch works great, and yes please—I could still use a hand with setup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still catching up, but I’ll check the exact list and timing for the repair drive and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you’ve checked, and I’ll keep the porch ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll check the list and timing now and get back to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We still need a couple more hands for setup and sorting tools on Saturday—can you pitch in for an hour?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I can help for an hour with setup and sorting tools on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Rey — thank you! I’ll put you down for an hour and send the setup details.
